revisionNote: The verified public commit adds only the handoff document after the tested runtime commit. This release-status file is documentation only; its containing commit may be newer without changing the tested runtime.

lifesteal.scope: DREAM only; actual main-hero and hunter/slayer party lifesteal commit paths
lifesteal.qualification: The inspected native lifesteal was damage-proportional without a per-second maximum-HP cap. This identified sustain contributor is limited; other damage mitigation, invulnerability and awakening protection are separate and unchanged. No claim of a full-campaign subjective balance certification.

wrathProgression.cause: The authoritative FLOW gate excluded noncombat actors, but the shared combat-clear predicate, exit rendering and one native interaction path required an empty raw enemy array. A retained noncombat actor kept full auto in hostiles-or-waves even after canonical clear.

mirrorLaser.scope: extra DREAM mirror laser owned by __HAPIL_MIRROR_V31347__

dreamBrowser.baselineComparison: The pinned old PC build remained in ep1b07 and incorrectly requested combat while FLOW.gate was clear. The new build transitioned to ep1b08 through the original movement/portal route.
dreamBrowser.scope: Real renderer and native startup, followed by explicit checkpoint and post-defeat fixtures. Native QA invokes the original death handler. These are not natural DREAM boss kills, the user's exact save, or complete campaigns.

verification.countingNote: Regression bundles overlap. Do not add the 22 core suites, 10 outer release entries, nested assertions or staged screenshots as independent campaigns.

history.reason: First wrath consistency patch covered exit rendering/interaction but the shared combat-clear predicate still held auto progression in combat. The observed baseline assertion and shared predicate were corrected; the final run is a new passing run, not a relabeled old result.

deployment.scope: Read-only published file hashes and actual initial STORY combat in three emulated browser profiles. The new mirror removal is observed and DREAM-only healing remains disabled in STORY. No HTTP-response replacement, HP injection or progress injection.

newAudioAttachments.reason: Repeated ClientError from the local container/Python execution service prevented reading and decoding mounted files. Files read also provided no readable audio content. No imaginary hashes, binaries or playable URLs were substituted.
newAudioAttachments.existingEightCombatAssets: preserved and verified separately; not the new twenty attachments

limitations: Twenty new audio attachments are still unimported
Wrath regression is a controlled post-defeat reproduction, not the user's exact save
No physical iPhone/Safari or low-end Android benchmark
No claim that unbounded lifesteal was the only possible contributor to survivability
